findings: The pair planner rejects baseline #2776471 remove plus #2776792 remove before checking retained #3053713.
Baseline disposition is incorrectly owned by the active pair instead of the displayed baseline edition.
Read-only SQLite confirms pending direct comparisons between all three editions; preserving #3053713 can use its two remove_existing_continue decisions.
decisions: Freeze group intent; resolve a surviving edition before making pair operations. Every removal must reference a direct current comparison with an edition retained by the batch. No transitive inferred evidence or relaxed preservation guards.

Make baseline disposition and its explicit page choices consistent across active comparisons, while keeping each peer selection and Shift anchor. Preserve drafts through hide/filter/reopen; invalidate changed evidence.

Keep actual removed gallery IDs in confirmations/errors, execute every requested exclusion once and reload current revisions. Preflight entire batch before mutation, preserve partial success and remaining choices on failure.
Retain existing one-merge-per-batch limit, asynchronous background workflow, original backups/quarantine, privacy and previous preview/navigation changes.
No real album exclusions/merges for verification. Do not interrupt recording/download jobs, force-exit or publish.

Compound baseline replacement with partial page merges remains blocked before writes; apply a partial merge against the intended retained baseline separately. Existing baseline-kept single trailing merge and single-pair behavior remain supported.
acceptance: Reproduce screenshot combination before the fix.
Test any kept edition regardless of baseline or active row; all-remove guard remains.
Test missing/stale direct evidence, reverse relations, duplicate or changing decisions, full group execution and partial-failure retry.
Test Ctrl/Shift selections across activation/hide/reopen/filter, partial merge restrictions and stale fingerprint invalidation.

Run related regression/type/build and isolated production React browser verification. Native restart only through default graceful gate; leave active work intact and report any blocked installed-app verification.
